title: Svatantra Microfin IPO
summary: Svatantra Microfin IPO is a ₹3,000 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Svatantra Microfin IPO has a total issue size of 3000 crore and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Svatantra Microfin financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Svatantra Microfin Limited is an NBFC-MFI incorporated in February 2012 with a specialization in the provision of financial services to economically weaker sections and financially underserved individuals throughout India. The Company offers microfinance loans to customers using the Joint Liability Group (JLG) model with an emphasis on women borrowers residing in rural and semi-urban parts of India. Moreover, the Company offers loans to a select few non-JLG borrowers through a separate lending and underwriting channel. In addition, through its subsidiary, SMHFCL, the Company also has a secured housing finance business. · · The Company has been able to create a geographically diversified microfinance network with pan India coverage owing to the technologically-enabled and phygital operating model in borrower acquisition, underwriting, disbursement and collections. The borrower-centric model, effective risk management system and efficient collections have enabled the Company to have strong asset quality and consistent growth despite fluctuating macro-economic conditions. Besides, the Company enjoys strong relationships with lenders, good credit rating and lower cost of borrowings.
Ananyashree Birla, Antimatter Media Pvt.Ltd. are the company's promoters of Svatantra Microfin.
